article.story: OXFORD, Miss. -- — Adam “Budd” Clark scored 23 points and led five in double-figure scoring for Mississippi in a 91-51 victory over Southeastern Louisiana on Tuesday night. Clark shot 10 of 13 from the floor. Ilias Kamardine and Corey Stephenson added 12 points apiece for Ole Miss (3-0), which shot 34 of 66 from the floor and made 8 of 19 shots from distance. Kamardine and Ben Henshall each had seven of the Rebels' 23 assists. Ole Miss scored 50 points in the paint and 39 points from 23 SE Louisiana turnovers. The Rebels have surpassed 90 points in each of their three games this season. Santiago Trouet scored 12 points off the bench for the Rebels, and reserve Christian Brown chipped in with 11 points. Jackson Furman scored 13 points to lead SE Louisiana (1-2). Ole Miss outscored the Lions 32-7 from the midway point of the first half and led 49-20 at the break. Stephenson and Trouet scored 10 first-half points for the Rebels. The Rebels are 21-0 in the series that dates to 1956. Up next SE Louisiana: at Texas A&M on Monday. Ole Miss: hosts Nicholls on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
